If you have any questions, please feel free to contact me, or the support team. You can also visit our support knowledge base which provides helpful hints for the entire platform as well as our forum page where other researchers share their questions and thoughts.If you like, we can arrange a brief meeting to demo our product and discuss your project. Our calendar is shared here and our schedule is wide open these days. Looking forward to speaking with you.Best,Sara--Avicenna Research (formerly Ethica Data)4109 - 295 Adelaide St W, Toronto, ON M5V 0L4, Canada Email: sales@avicennaresearch.com - Web: https://avicennaresearch.com--
